name: SMAD family member 3

function.text: SMAD3 encodes SMAD family member 3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to aneurysm-osteoarthritis syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.

selection_reason: Panel membership with educational coverage; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
